title: Floodlight — a fast, native Spotlight alternative for macOS
excerpt: Floodlight is a fast, native, open-source Spotlight alternative. It finds apps, files, folders, and settings from one keyboard-first panel and keeps every index on your Mac.
content_html:
Fast local search on Mac

A fast, native, open-source Spotlight alternative.

  • Instant resultsResults in less than a millisecond
  • Stop clicking the wrong thingYour selection stays put
  • Small install size6.2 MB binary
  • Just searchNo bundled JS, no cloud, no ads
